defaultManifest.$comment: (id: Id, domains: Id[], hasModels: boolean, contract: string) => PacketManifest

contract.description: the contract version the packet was built for (CONTRACT_VERSION); the reader checks the major

id.description: unique among the loaded packets; the namespace of the browser's marks (`explorer-verify-v1:<id>`)

name.description: shown in the header and the run list

family.description: the problem family whose generic views apply (`palladio-architecture`: the Model panel over the InputModel, the Interactions tab, the plugin's detail); absent: a plain multi-objective packet (runs, designs, architecture graph)

domains.description: the domains of the packet (domains/<id>.json); a run belongs to the packet of its domain

builtBy.description: the builder (command or script) that wrote the packet

fingerprint.description: hash over the inputs' hashes (and the builder's code): two builds from the same inputs have the same one

inputs.description: what the packet was built from, with content hashes: the backend reports the packet stale when one changed

roots.description: named directories, relative to the packet directory (or absolute): what `cwd`, source trees and inputs are relative to

objectives.description: the objectives, constraints and metrics the packet's runs report: labels, units, directions, their doc's key

vocabulary.description: the words of the problem: mechanisms and styles a design chooses, with labels and explanations

docs.description: name -> file under the packet (docs/*.json or *.md); served inlined with the manifest (GET /api/packets/:id)

capabilities.description: what the explorer shows for this packet

sources.description: named source trees the evidence of the Verify parts (and the Model panel's paths) point into

commands.description: commands the backend may run for this packet (`simulate`: a design's detail, `rebuild`: the packet again). A command runs only when the backend's LOCAL configuration allows it for this packet (server.local.json `allowCommands`, or EXPLORER_ALLOW_COMMANDS); a packet never enables its own commands

root.description: a root of `roots` the path is relative to (default: the packet directory)

code.description: O1 … O5, C1 …: the short code the docs use

doc.description: the key of its entry in docs `metrics` (default: `key`)

mechanisms.description: the mechanisms of an access or call site (sync, async, cache, copy, join, …)

styles.description: the styles of a workflow (choreography, orchestration)

operationKinds.description: the kinds of operations (query, mutation, reaction, …)

edges.description: the edge layers of the architecture graph (its legend, the mechanism badges, the edges' tooltips): the mechanisms of the accesses (sync, copy, cache, join, saga, local) and `feed`, `event`, `reference`; `about` is the legend's tooltip

model.description: the Model panel (needs an input model, models/<domain>.json, and the family palladio-architecture)

modelTabs.description: the Model panel's tabs, in this order (default: all the input model supports)

performance.description: the Performance panel (precomputed, cached or simulated details)

simulate.description: opening a design's performance may simulate it now (the command `simulate`, or the dummy simulator)

ModelTabId.description: a model tab of the Model panel (capability `model`)

SourceTree.description: A source tree: `git` reads the files of a repository at a commit (`git show <ref>:<path>`), `dir` the working tree of a directory, restricted to the `allow` prefixes. Paths are relative to `root` (a key of `roots`) or the packet.

parts.description: verify/parts.json: the parts with their claims and evidence (contract/verify.ts `VerifyParts`)

causes.description: verify/causes.json: per operation part what it causes downstream (`VerifyCauses`)

chains.description: verify/chains.json: per operation the functions from its entry to its steps (`VerifyChains`)

PacketCommand.description: A command: `argv` with placeholders `{name}` the backend fills (always: packet, the packet directory, and every root by its name; simulate: model, diff, out, request, build; rebuild: exportArgs, the input model's recorded export arguments — an argument that is only an array placeholder expands to several), run in `cwd` (a key of `roots` or a path relative to the packet)

allowedCommands.description: the commands the local configuration allows for this packet

stale.description: inputs that changed since the build (staleness)

implicit.description: the packet came without packet.json (a plain bundle)

PacketBody.description: GET /api/packets/:id: the manifest with its docs inlined (JSON parsed, Markdown as text)

Mechanism.description: How one access of an operation to a class in another service is realised in a design (a decision). An access within the operation's own service has no mechanism (1.12.0: `local` is gone; its placement is "no hop", `DerivedAccess`).

ConsistencyLevel.description: (1.13.0) how current a read (or a call's answer) must be, curated per read by the case: `strict` current data only (sync only; a copy only where today's code reads its own store), `stale-ok` a cache or a copy may serve it (priced by O4), `immutable` as stale-ok, but a stale answer cannot be wrong (O4 counts no staleness). Replaces the flag `strong` (contract/consistency.ts `levelOf` accepts the older spelling `strong`).

Consistency.description: (1.13.0) a read's or a call's curated consistency: its level, the rule ids that decide it (the case's `InputModel.consistency.rules`, e.g. S2, R1, I1) and the reason in the case's words; `lock` a statement that only locks (a strict read of the locked class)

Placement.description: (1.12.0) where the two sides of a call run, as the UI names it (never a mechanism): `noHop` caller and callee in one container (a direct call: no middleware, no network, no receiving envelope), `remote` in different containers (the hop: both sidecars' middleware and the network; a synchronous call also pays the callee's receiving envelope).

PlanVia.description: (1.12.0) a request plan entry's `via` (`ModelRequest.plan[].via`, `ModelSite.planVia`): `root` the root resolver, `service` resolved in the service that resolves its parent (the root's service for a field on the root's objects), `gateway` a federation fetch by the gateway. Readers accept the older spelling `local` for `service` (`contract/plan.ts` planVia).

OperationKind.description: query/mutation: GraphQL entry points; handler: event handler; internal: lookups and resolvers no client calls.

sources.description: sources the backend read, with errors (e.g. "mdeo: dev instance not reachable, recorded responses used").

packets.description: (1.10.0) the data packets (contract/packet.ts): every run belongs to the packet of its domain

packet.description: (1.10.0) the packet the run belongs to (set by the backend)

designCount.description: designs whose decisions are known (archive, final population, references, or all evaluated)

modelFingerprint.description: (1.5.0) the fingerprint of the seed the run started from (contract/hash.ts modelFingerprint): a run whose seed is none of the input model's seeds was made with an earlier model

location.description: run directory, bundle path or base URL

synthetic.description: true when the data is synthetic (dummy generator)

ConstraintDef.description: A constraint value is its violation: 0 = satisfied, > 0 = by how much it is violated.

MetricDef.description: Further per-design scalars (reported, not optimised), e.g. services, sync calls, mean response time.

packet.description: (1.10.0) the packet the run belongs to (set by the backend)

designCount.description: designs whose decisions are known (archive, final population, references, or all evaluated)

modelFingerprint.description: (1.5.0) the fingerprint of the seed the run started from (contract/hash.ts modelFingerprint): a run whose seed is none of the input model's seeds was made with an earlier model

history.description: per generation (index 0 = initial population); empty when the source does not report them

archive.description: design ids of the external archive at the end (headless runs)

finalPopulation.description: design ids of the final population (dev-instance executions: its reported front)

references.description: reference designs evaluated with the same evaluator (today's cut, knee, monolith, ...)

evaluation.description: (1.0.0) how every design of the run was evaluated: one simulation per design (docs/quality.md, Simulation of a design)

raw.description: the source's config as is (mdeo .config fields, harness env)

profile.description: the load profile variant: `day` (C4's compressed day) or `steady` (the design load)

warmUpS.description: measured window [warmUpS, endS] and the per-bin series' bin width, s

maxPods.description: pods the HPA may create in one simulation (beyond: capped, infeasible)

phases.description: the profile's phases (C's `profiles.<id>.phases`): name and start, s

latency.description: C1's policy: the statistic per request type (mean, p50, p90, p95), the factor on the reference's statistic, the reference completions a budget needs

budgets.description: C1's budget per request type (RequestType ids) under this profile, ms; request types without one are not checked

peakCapacity.description: C2: the containers (model entity names) whose per-bin utilisation must stay at most at `limit`

pluginVersion.description: the plugin build the run's build directory serves (`<date>+<git hash>`)

EvaluationSetup.description: (1.0.0) The evaluation of a run's designs (docs/quality.md, Simulation of a design): one SimOxide simulation of the realised model per design (the plugin's pcmEvaluate) with the model's load profile; read from the run's seed model and its build by the case packet's export-run.ts.

population.description: the population after this generation; `d` only when the design's decisions are known

PopulationPoint.description: One individual: objective values (order of Run.objectives), constraint violations, optional design id.

method.description: e.g. "Monte Carlo, 200 000 Halton samples, normalised box"

ideal.description: normalisation box in the objectives' own units, per objective; minimisation form; (1.5.0) absent when the source computed the values with a box it does not report (the platform's own hypervolume)

population.description: per generation: hypervolume of the feasible non-dominated points of the population (null: not computed)

archive.description: per generation: of the archive at that generation (headless runs); may be sampled (null between)

hash.description: hash of the canonical decisions (contract/hash.ts); the cache key for details

rank.description: non-domination rank among the run's feasible designs (0 = front); null if infeasible

born.description: generation the design was first seen / left the archive

hasDecisions.description: decisions known (false for designs only known by objective values)

hash.description: hash of the canonical decisions (contract/hash.ts); the cache key for details

rank.description: non-domination rank among the run's feasible designs (0 = front); null if infeasible

born.description: generation the design was first seen / left the archive

hasDecisions.description: decisions known (false for designs only known by objective values)

rawDecisions.description: the source's decisions as is, when they cannot be mapped (e.g. layer-2 link maps of older runs)

mechanisms.description: Mechanism per access whose class lives in another service than the operation runs in. Key `${operationId}|${classId}|${mode}`. Accesses within one service have no mechanism and are not listed.

sagas.description: saga style per business process whose steps span several services

operationPlacement.description: where an operation runs, if not in the service of its home class

effects.description: (1.4.0) per effect step (call site, `Domain.effectSites`): its mechanism and whether it joins the caller's transaction in this design

homes.description: (1.4.0) the chosen home class per operation whose home is a decision (`Domain.homes`)

joined.description: in the caller's transaction (realisation shape `joined`): a local call, no envelope, no commit, no message

why.description: not joined: why (the first that holds, in the order apart, servers, orchestrated; external, chosen)

together.description: caller and provider share a container

EffectState.description: (1.4.0) an effect step in one design

EffectMechanism.description: (1.4.0) an effect step's mechanism: in the caller's transaction, a synchronous step, an asynchronous message

JoinBlocker.description: (1.4.0) why an effect step does not join the caller's transaction (core/mdeo/transform/realise/plan-placement.mt `pj`): `apart` caller and provider in different containers, `servers` the two schemas on different database servers, `orchestrated` a step of an orchestrated workflow (a saga step), `external` the trigger is outside the system (a provider callback: async only), `chosen` the design chose another mechanism (sync or async)

kind.description: how today's code implements it: a write of another class, an event reaction, a provider callback

class.description: the class whose work it is (B: the written class, the reaction's or callback's home class)

callee.description: the reaction or callback operation (events, callbacks)

home.description: the step sits in a home option's SEFF: the option's class (inert unless chosen)

callerSchema.description: the schemas that must share a database server to join (CallSite.callerSchema, providerSchema)

callerClass.description: the class whose component makes the call (the caller's container decides `together`)

EffectSite.description: (1.4.0) an effect step of the model (docs/model.md, Call sites): operation A causes a change at class B

DesignFile.description: runs/<run>/designs.json in a bundle: every design with its decisions

DesignStreamHeader.description: runs/<run>/designs.jsonl in a bundle (since 0.2.0, preferred over designs.json when present): line 1 is this header, then one `Design` per line (JSON, no line breaks inside a line).

source.description: where it was extracted from (commit, files)

requests.description: client request types (GraphQL documents); the gateway plan runs their operations

loadProfiles.description: load profiles over time (sessions/s and mix), e.g. package C's "day" and "steady"

cuts.description: named reference cuts: today's 16 services, a monolith, ...

effectSites.description: (1.4.0) the model's effect steps; a design's `Decisions.effects` holds their state

homes.description: (1.4.0) operations whose home (entry point) is a decision among the classes they write in their transaction

homeClass.description: the class the operation is anchored on; it runs in this class's service unless placed otherwise

rate.description: requests per second at the reference load

budgetMs.description: latency budget, ms (the dummy bundles only)

level.description: (1.13.0) reads: how current the data must be (strict: no copy or cache), with the curated rules and reason of its statements at that level; absent: stale-ok

lock.description: (1.13.0) one of its statements only locks (a strict read of the locked class)

strong.description: the older spelling of `level` (needs fresh data: no copy or cache allowed), read by `levelOf`

joined.description: part of a cross-class join or transaction with the operation's other accesses

class.description: the class whose changes the event carries

steps.description: operations in order; a step's writes in another service than the trigger's make the process a saga

transaction.description: (1.3.0) a transaction workflow (`tx_<SEFF>`, layer 2's `Workflow.transactional`, docs/model.md Workflows): no business process but the transaction of the trigger, whose transaction-bound writes of other classes are the steps (`steps` stays empty); a saga while one of these classes sits in another service than the trigger

operations.description: operations the gateway plan runs, root first

rate.description: requests per second at the reference load

budgetMs.description: latency budget, ms (the dummy bundles; a run's budgets are in its `config.evaluation.budgets`)

share.description: share of the sessions at the reference mix

steps.description: request types in order of first use; repeat: expected visits per session (may be fractional); probability: optional step

mix.description: share of each session type over time (keys: SessionType ids)

origin.description: precomputed (exported with the run), simulated (on demand), synthetic (dummy)

version.description: the plugin build that simulated it (`<date>+<git hash>`)

durationS.description: end of the run and start of the measured window, s

status.description: a failed simulation, or one stopped at the pod or event limit, makes the design infeasible (C1 1000, C2 1)

load.description: the load profile simulated: sessions started per second and the session mix per bin

hpa.description: the HPA over all scaling groups

model.description: the simulated model: the one the search evaluated (a reference, a saved solution) or rebuilt from the seed and the design's decision links

constraints.description: C1 and C2 recomputed from this simulation with the run's budgets and limit (compare with the design's values)

DesignDetail.description: (1.0.0) The simulation of one design: the plugin's `detail` run of the design's realised model with exactly the request the search evaluated it with (core/tools/design_detail.sh), so its `evaluation` is the search's pcmEvaluate result. Statistics cover the measured window; the per-bin series cover the window in `binS` bins (`t` = bin starts, s).

key.description: operation, request type or session type id

budgetMs.description: C1's budget of a request type (the run's EvaluationSetup.budgets)

statisticMs.description: C1's statistic of this series (EvaluationSetup.latency.statistic), ms

overTime.description: per bin (completion time): mean, p95, completions per second

service.description: a scaling group's container (a service's container, the gateway)

replicas.description: pods (ready + starting), time mean per bin

ready.description: ready pods, time mean per bin

maxBinUtilisation.description: the largest per-bin utilisation (C2's quantity for a PeakCapacity container)

peakCapacity.description: a container C2 checks (database servers, broker)

pods.description: pods of all groups per bin (ready + starting), and ready

commit.description: the commit of the system's repository the extraction was read at

timing.description: (1.1.0) where the model's demands come from, detected from the data (absent: the seed's timings)

inputs.description: the files the export read, as repo paths of this project; (1.5.0) with their content hash (sha256) and, for a realised seed, the model it was realised from with that model's hash at the time (its `// Source:` line)

exportArgs.description: (1.5.0) the exporter's arguments, to export again with the same inputs

freshness.description: (1.5.0) set by the backend when it serves the model: whether the inputs are still the exported ones

origin.description: the files the model comes from (origin), as repo paths

requests.description: request types of the usage model (login excluded: the identity provider's token, no SEFF of the system)

designSessionsPerS.description: design load: sessions per second of the realistic workload's base mix

profiles.description: (1.0.0) the load profiles of the model variants (LoadProfile, LoadStep): what every design is simulated with

seffs.description: the SEFFs of the derived model as timed parts (the base model, before the realisation adds middleware)

sites.description: call sites (decisions: the mechanism of one call)

topics.description: (1.2.0) package A's topics with their roles (domain/REPORT.md §5)

homes.description: (1.4.0) the operations whose home is a decision (layer 2's Home): the candidate classes (each with its SEFF), the class the gateway's call is written to, and the seeds' choices

envelopes.description: (1.11.0) the receiving envelopes (ReceivingEnvelope): per class component and callee service the envelope a synchronous call across containers into one of `services` (signature names) pays there; `seff` its SEFF (kind envelope)

parameters.description: the decision layer's parameters (cost model, reliability, middleware costs, mechanism options, ...)

consistency.description: (1.13.0) the case's texts of the consistency levels and of the rule ids the reads' and calls' `rules` name (e.g. S2: "invariant guard not re-checked …"), and where they are curated

notes.description: inconsistencies the exporter noticed in its inputs

InputModel.description: The optimisation's input model (family palladio-architecture): how the system enters the optimisation (models/<domainId>.json in a packet, written by the case's exporter, served at GET /api/domains/:id/model). Everything is read from the derived model (its realised seeds), the case's extraction and workload and the metamodel files at export time.

envelope.description: (1.4.0) the effect steps' envelope: `measured-v3` the parts' measured `envelope`

kApplied.description: the demands carry the at-load factor k_c of the container that ran them today

mapShare.description: the mapping CPU's share of the application CPU, weighted by the request rates (campaign only)

ModelTiming.description: (1.1.0) the timing source of a model family (the case's timing campaign): `campaign-v3` the timing campaign's parts of schema version 3 (own CPU by counters, database CPU and mapping CPU per access, × k_c of today's container, with the request overhead and the measured envelope).

fingerprint.description: a seed: its fingerprint as model data (contract/hash.ts modelFingerprint), to match runs made from it

source.description: a realised seed: the model it was realised from, and what that model was generated from (`// Input:` lines); hashes may be prefixes

ModelInput.description: (1.5.0) a file the input model was exported from

state.description: (1.10.0) `stale`: an input changed and the backend may not rebuild the packet (its local configuration allows no `rebuild`)

ModelFreshness.description: (1.5.0) the input model against its inputs now: `current` every input as exported; `updating` an input changed and the backend exports again (ask again shortly); `failed` that export failed (`error`). `unrealised`: realised seeds older than the model they were realised from (core/tools/realise-seeds.sh realises them again); `ungenerated`: the models older than what core/generator/derive.py generated them from (the generator, the extraction, the workload, the timings: generate them again, then realise).

design.description: the documentation section that describes it

evidence.description: path:line of its table in the system's repository

component.description: the PCM assemblies of the class component and of its schema

placement.description: the seeds' placement: the class component's container and the schema's database server

upper.description: upper bound of the target end: 1 or -1 (many)

storage.description: fk, join table, id array, ... (package A)

table.description: (1.6.0) held in a join table of its own: its links are the source's data, not its rows

inverse.description: (1.6.0) the other end's field (Category.products for Product.categories)

trigger.description: GraphQL field, topic or HTTP route

entry.description: path:line of its entry point in the system's repository

homeClass.description: its home class: it runs in this class's component, so in the service the cut puts the class in

cpuMs.description: own work, ms (the campaign: own CPU × k_c, without the mapping; else the seed's timings)

envelopeMs.description: (1.11.0) the part of cpuMs that is the callee's receiving envelope of today's invocation across services (measured inside it): its SEFFs' work is cpuMs - envelopeMs; the envelope block pays it where the call has its hop

mapCpuMs.description: (1.1.0) mapping CPU of the home class's own accesses per execution, ms (Σ of their Access.cpuMs): the model folds it into the SEFF's `work` action (work = cpuMs + mapCpuMs); the export shows it as a part `map` (split)

effectCalls.description: (1.13.0) its effect calls: a change outside the system (a registration with an external provider, `to` the provider's endpoint), which reads nothing: sync only, never cached or copied (rule E1); the provider's callback is a call site of its own (kind callback)

process.description: process (saga) it belongs to, with its role

seffs.description: its SEFFs: its own, and one per request type whose root resolver it is

reach.description: per request type: executions per request (through plans, calls and events)

rate.description: executions per second at the design load

level.description: (1.13.0) reads: the model's Access.level (the strictest of the statements it stands for; the derivation decides its mechanisms by it), with the curated rules and reasons of its statements at that level (none for a read that is not strong: stale-ok without a rule); writes: none

lock.description: (1.13.0) one of its statements only locks the class (a strict read: the lock is taken on the current row)

strong.description: the older spelling of `level`: the extraction's flag that the read decides a write or check (read by `levelOf`)

cpuMs.description: mapping CPU (app-side persistence) per execution, ms; 0 under the seed's timings. For another class an InternalAction `map` in that class's access SEFF, for the home class's own data part of the operation's `work`

dbMs.description: database time per execution, ms (the campaign's database CPU, or the seed's timings split)

local.description: the home class's own data (a call into its schema) or another class (through that class's component)

today.description: how today's code reaches it (local, copy, call, payload)

via.description: the reference it reads or writes (its id, e.g. Product.categories); (1.6.0) every access of an association has one: with `class` the reference's source and the reference in a join table, the access touches only the links, not the class's rows. An operation has one access per class, mode and reference; the SEFF's call per class and mode is shared by them

level.description: (1.13.0) the model's Call.level: strict is sync only (no call site, nor its nested fields' calls), stale-ok a call site sync / cache; with the curated rules and reason

nestedIn.description: (1.13.0) a field resolved on this operation's objects in that operation's invocation (one invocation into nested fields): its level, rules and reason are that call's

strong.description: the older spelling of `level` (strong: sync only), read by `levelOf`

ModelCall.description: a call of another operation's logic

styles.description: the Workflow decision: allowed coordination styles and the seeds' choices

workflow.description: (1.3.0) the layer-2 Workflow: `saga_<Process>`, or `tx_<SEFF>` (= id) for a transaction workflow

transaction.description: (1.3.0) a transaction workflow (`Workflow.transactional`; `steps` and `compensations` stay empty): the trigger operation's SEFF (and its request), the steps as call sites (its transaction-bound writes) and their classes. Co-located with the trigger a step is a local call in its transaction (orchestrated: no coordination, no commit of its own); separated it commits on its own, orchestrated after the orchestrator's coordination

HomeRef.description: (1.4.0) a home option of an operation; its SEFF and its sites are inert while another option is chosen

plan.description: the gateway plan: root resolver first, then the further fields (`via`: PlanVia, root, service, gateway; accepts the older spelling `local`); (1.8.0) a tree in the document's order: `parent` is the index of the entry whose objects the field is resolved on (0: the root's)

rate.description: requests per second at the design load

budgets.description: (1.0.0) C1 per load profile: today's simulated statistic (the reference) and the budget (factor × it)

seff.description: the gateway's SEFF for this request type

work.description: sum of the demands one request makes (no middleware, no queueing), ms of one full core; (1.1.0) `map` the mapping CPU within `app`, `wait` the latency-only waits (DELAY demands; not CPU, in none of the others); (1.4.0) as the neutral seed realises it: a joined effect step without its envelope and commit

visits.description: expected visits per session per request type

model.description: the realised model it was read from

steps.description: per session type (null: every scenario) from `timeS` on its arrival rate is `factor` × the model's

baseRates.description: the model's arrival rate per session type, sessions/s

latency.description: C1's policy in this model (LatencyBudgetPolicy; absent: the p95 against OperationLatencyBudget.ms)

ModelProfile.description: (1.0.0) a model variant's load profile (architecture.mm LoadProfile with its LoadSteps, C's phases)

kind.description: (1.1.0) cache: a provider's cache as built (CallSite.cachedService), reached only when a design uses it; (1.4.0) step: an effect step's step form `I<B>.<x>_step` (envelope, the work, the commit), commit: its commit `<B>Db.<x>_commit` (the commit wait); (1.7.0) fetch: a federation fetch (CallSite.fetchService), the subgraph's glue resolver's work and then the field, reached only when a design composes the field across containers; (1.11.0) envelope: a component's receiving envelope (ReceivingEnvelope.envelope), called by the realisation after a synchronous call with its hop

home.description: (1.4.0) the SEFF of a home option (`<Cls>_req<Request>`): the operation, the candidate class, whether it is the written (today's) one

name.description: the action's entity name (work, sql, readOrder, eventX, fieldX, root, db, ...)

ms.description: work: mean demand, ms of one full core (a DELAY: ms of waiting)

kind.description: call: db (own schema), access (another class's component), call, event, callback, field, root; (1.4.0) work and commit: a step form's call into the step's work and into its commit

p.description: expected executions per execution of the SEFF (branch probability, loop count)

async.description: inside an asynchronous fork (the neutral seed's provider callbacks)

site.description: the call site deciding its mechanism

split.description: (1.1.0) work split by the exporter from the action's demand (the home class's mapping CPU out of `work`), not an action of its own

estimate.description: (1.4.0) a step form's envelope whose value is an estimate (the model's ReceivingEnvelope.estimate); (1.11.0) on a call part with `envelopeMs`: that value is an estimate

envelopeMs.description: (1.11.0) call: a call into an operation of a ReceivingEnvelope: the callee's receiving envelope (ms CPU, k_c applied) that the call pays in the callee's container when it crosses containers synchronously (with its hop); none within a container. The callee's work in the base model is without it.

SeffPart.description: one part of a SEFF: own work (an InternalAction's demand) or a call (with its multiplicity)

op.description: the operation whose SEFF makes the call, and the request for a request's SEFF

kind.description: the call's kind (as SeffPart.kind) and target: a class (accesses) or an operation

allowed.description: allowed mechanisms: sync, async, cache, copy, join, joinCache

event.description: (0.4.0) event sites: the domain event the caller raises, whose reaction `callee` is (one site per raise and reaction)

planVia.description: (0.4.0) field sites: today's gateway plan entry of the field (PlanVia: `service` the service that resolves its parent resolves it, `gateway` a federation fetch; accepts the older spelling `local`)

copyFeed.description: (0.4.0) sites that allow a LocalCopy: who feeds the copy (the copy sync's CopyFeed.writers, as the operations whose writes they are, with the request for a request's SEFF); no writers: the copy comes with the saga message (event-carried)

home.description: (1.4.0) a site in a home option's SEFF: inert (no objective changes) while another option is chosen

hitRatio.description: (1.1.0) the site's own cache hit ratio (TTL-60 s cache over its key stream); replaces the mechanism's

staleShare.description: (1.1.0) the share of its hits whose key was written after the entry was stored; O4 uses it instead of min(1, w·TTL)

cachedService.description: (1.1.0) the provider's cached operation (CallSite.cachedService): joinCache is the provider's entity cache

cachedSeff.description: (1.1.0) its SEFF (kind cache): hit = the provider's hit CPU, miss = the call's own operation

fetchService.description: (1.7.0) the provider's federation fetch (CallSite.fetchService): across containers the gateway's join calls it instead of the field (the subgraph finds the entity it contributes the field to: its `_entities` glue resolver's work)

family.description: (1.2.0) what the interaction is for: `fetch` gets data of another class, the caller needs the answer (reads of another class, request fields; 1.13.0: calls of another operation with a site); `effect` runs a step of the work in another class, the caller does not (writes of another class, process events, provider callbacks)

effect.description: (1.2.0) effect sites: the attributes the allowed mechanisms and today's follow from

copyTopics.description: (1.2.0) sites that allow a LocalCopy: the topics of package A (domain/REPORT.md §5) that feed the reader's copy today (`today`), else the topics that carry the class (what would feed a copy)

bound.description: a write in the operation's transaction with its home class: a saga step when the cut separates them

p.description: expected executions per execution of the caller (a raise's outcome probability; 1 for writes)

cascades.description: what follows on the other side: the reaction's own call sites and the events it raises (none for a write)

external.description: the trigger is outside the system (a provider's callback): async only

step.description: (1.4.0) the step as built: the step form's SEFF (envelope, work, commit; what the call reaches unless it joins), the work's SEFF (what a joined call reaches), the commit's SEFF, the envelope's CPU per execution (ms, its container's base rate) and whether that value is an estimate; the schemas that must share a database server

joined.description: (1.4.0) whether the step joins its caller's transaction in the seeds, and else why not

SiteEffect.description: (1.2.0) an effect site's attributes (docs/model.md, Call sites)

TopicRole.description: (1.2.0) the role of a topic in package A (domain/REPORT.md §5)

subscribers.description: `copy`: the subscriber only maintains a copy (not an operation of the model, A2)

ModelTopic.description: (1.2.0) a topic of package A: replication topics feed copies (part of fetch), process topics are effects

component.description: the class component it runs in

services.description: the signatures (entity names) whose synchronous calls across containers pay it

ModelEnvelope.description: (1.11.0) a receiving envelope: what `service`'s application spends on a synchronous request it receives across containers

links.description: links to other objects (names), e.g. a ContainerPrice's containers

id.description: domain, architecture, palladio (the microservices layer is part of architecture)

files.description: repo paths of the parsed files

used.description: instances of the class or its subclasses in today's realised seed model
